authorized_claims: On the fixed 60-item validation cohort, depth-7 frozen-static retained 9.660873 MiB/document versus 136.235352 MiB/document for full-prefix, a 14.1018x Store reduction, while mean F1 was 0.542368 versus dense 0.542888 and Q16 replay 0.546238.
Frozen-static's paired mean F1 delta versus Q16 replay was -0.003870 with 95% bootstrap interval [-0.020365, 0.010756], and none of 60 item deltas was <= -0.5.

The same-memory mixed policy saved only 2.75% Store relative to frozen-static while having a more negative F1 point estimate and one catastrophic item; the minus-25% policy reached 18.0778x compression but had a Q16-relative F1 interval wholly below zero and five catastrophic items.
store_estimand: Per-document retained tensor payload: packed boundary-residual data/scales/biases plus unique lower-cache tensor storage, as recorded by stored_persistent_nbytes.
